summary.text: Dark path dao marks are law traces of dark path. They linger after dark path beasts fight, densify in Earth Trench sites, and support concealment, resource points, and shadow-born beasts.

claims.text: Fang Yuan reads lingering marks at a battle site and assigns the dark path dao marks to the vanishing shadow leopard, noting they are sparse against denser red fire path marks from whatever killed it. Concentration and intertwining of those marks show an intense fight, and sparse dark path marks against denser opposing marks still support a rank six or higher killer.
General dao marks and attainment levels are covered on dao marks and attainment.
The eyes of the myriad eyes clear bull are full of dark path dao marks. When Fang Yuan obtains them, many dark path wild mortal Gu, mostly rank five, are still inside and cannot escape in time.

Inside Earth Trench, earth path and dark path dao marks are in the highest quantity. Fang Yuan chooses the site for earth path calamities, but heaven’s will forms a dark path earthly calamity instead. Afterward his dark path dao marks rise to near ten thousand, a gain of at least nine thousand in that one calamity despite a previously weak dark path mark foundation.
After that earthly calamity’s dark path dao marks, Fang Yuan uses Dark Limit to hide from heaven’s will and finds the concealment many times better.

In Mini Western Desert, the rotten black swamp forms when Fang Yuan undergoes tribulation and is filled with dark path dao marks. He modifies it into a dark path Gu worm resource point whose production is still low when newly made.

Shadow monsters are usually born in areas with dense dark path dao marks, and Plunder Shadow Earth Trench is such a place. A Gu formation there is arranged using those dense dark path dao marks: only mortal Gu are used, yet it has the might of an immortal Gu formation, and its best effect is to prevent others’ deductions.
